title: Rotting Oranges
statement: 0 is empty, 1 is a fresh orange, and 2 is a rotten orange. Every minute, a rotten orange rots its 4-directional fresh neighbors. Return the minutes until no fresh orange remains, or -1 if some fresh orange can never rot.
hints: Multi-source BFS: every initially rotten orange is a source at minute 0.
The minute of a cell is one more than the minute of the rotten neighbor that reached it.
If a fresh orange is never reached, return -1. The answer is the maximum minute written on a rotten cell.

approaches.name: Simulate minute by minute
approaches.explanation: Scan the whole grid each minute.

approaches.name: Multi-source BFS
approaches.explanation: Each cell is enqueued at most once.

editorial: Enqueue every rotten cell with time 0 and count the fresh cells. When you rot a fresh neighbor, decrement the fresh count and enqueue it with time + 1. If fresh remains, return -1. Otherwise return the last time you wrote, which is 0 when there was nothing to rot.

examples.explanation: Every fresh orange rots in 4 minutes.
